note: Re-confirmed 2026-09-08 after the functional-design redo jump, and re-saved following that confirmation. Coverage unchanged.

coverage.target: functional-spec.md > The not-yet-published state, and u9-guest-guide-view's frontend-components.md > NotYetPublishedNotice — a guest-framed placeholder carrying the property name, a plain statement that the host is still preparing the guide, and a prompt to contact them. Never an error, never blank, and never owner-facing wording

functional-spec.md > Workflow 1 steps 1-5, and u9-guest-guide-view's functional-spec.md > Workflow steps 1-2 and frontend-components.md > GuestGuideView and IdentityBlock — the identity paints as the first content, before tab content, the chat affordance and any theming asset, with a skeleton rather than a full-page spinner ahead of it. This unit owns the skeleton and decides when the guide renders; the ordering within the guide is a property of u9-guest-guide-view's structure, which is stronger than a convention each consumer follows because it also holds for u5-owner-guide's preview

functional-spec.md > Workflow 1 step 6 — the brand read and its accent-surface application are designed, and Q1 = A settled how it composes with the identity paint. Blocked on AC4.1.7: no frontend-reachable read returns a locality brand, so step 6 never completes and the base-token state is the only state a guest currently sees

functional-spec.md > Workflow 1 ('The unbranded state is a finished design') — a minimal brand resolves to the clean default look plus the name. u3-foundation's BR5.2 guarantees the token set is complete, so no component receives a partial one to half-render

functional-spec.md > What this unit does, and does not do; frontend-components.md > API integration points ('No authenticated call exists anywhere on this surface, and none may be added') — there is no account prompt, no upsell and no authenticated call on the guest surface

u9-guest-guide-view's frontend-components.md > IdentityBlock ('No image input, and none may be added') — the block has no image input at all, so a broken image, a grey placeholder or a stock photo is unreachable rather than merely avoided. u1-api-contract's BR3.4 keeps the absence true at the type boundary
frontend-components.md > LinkInvalidScreen — one message: the link is no longer valid, contact your host

frontend-components.md > LinkInvalidScreen ('It takes no cause input because there is nothing to take') — the component accepts no cause, so a mistyped token and an expired stay are indistinguishable by construction and no later change can branch on the difference

functional-spec.md > The route model, and frontend-components.md > LinkInvalidScreen — no raw status code or technical detail, and never a 404 page. u3-foundation's BR4.1 is what keeps a status code from reaching any screen

functional-spec.md > The route model ('A not-yet-started stay is not invalid') — a pre-check-in link renders the guide normally, because the resolver compares expiresAt only and never reads checkIn. The copy must not tell such a guest to contact their host, since the link is valid and doing so achieves nothing

functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 step 1, and u9-guest-guide-view's frontend-components.md > GuideTabs — three tabs render, Overview, Places and Events, per the human's Q3 = A decision. u2-design-system's BR3.6 guarantees one is always selected

functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 steps 4-6, and u9-guest-guide-view's frontend-components.md > GuideTabs ('No raw identifier is ever rendered'). The criterion has two halves in different states: its negative half — no raw id is ever displayed — is met today and is the half that matters for correctness. Its positive half, favourites appearing with name and category, is blocked on AC4.1.9 and recorded in functional-spec.md's traceability table

functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 step 5, and u9-guest-guide-view's frontend-components.md > GuideTabs — the empty panels carry AC2.3.3's wording, never a blank panel and never an error, and carry it in the accessibility tree per u2-design-system's BR3.3

functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 ('An absent events list does not break the page') — the rest of the guide renders regardless. This follows structurally from each panel owning its own empty state rather than the page branching on content presence

u9-guest-guide-view's frontend-components.md > GuideTabs, and functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 — the tab strip scrolls horizontally at mobile widths, which u2-design-system's BR3.7 provides and this unit must not override

frontend-components.md > ChatWidget ('It is persistent across tabs') — one instance, not re-mounted per tab. Re-mounting would lose the conversation on every tab change, which AC2.4.5 already loses on close

functional-spec.md > Workflow 3 step 3, and frontend-components.md > ChatWidget state table — the typing indicator escalates to an explicit note past roughly five seconds. This matters more than usual because the provider is null: a guest is waiting on something that will never answer

functional-spec.md > Workflow 3 step 4b, and frontend-components.md > ChatWidget state table, 504 row — history preserved, the last message retryable, never a silent hang. Per the human's Q2 = A decision this is the primary path rather than an afterthought, since it is what almost every guest gets

functional-spec.md > Workflow 3 ('The one path that does succeed'), and frontend-components.md > ChatWidget, sparse row — the assistant says so in its own reply rather than the UI changing state. It is the only demonstrable success path until a provider is configured, so it is what the scenario test exercises

functional-spec.md > Workflow 3 ('History does not survive close and reopen'), and frontend-components.md > ChatWidget. Blocked on AC4.1.6: chat history is not readable. Deliberately not worked around with browser storage, which would create a second history diverging from a backend that knows nothing about it and would need reconciling when AC4.1.6 lands

functional-spec.md > Workflow 3 ('AC2.4.6 is not a preference'), and frontend-components.md > ChatWidget ('enforced structurally, not by discipline') — the reply never reaches a raw-HTML injection API, enforced by the team's blocking lint rule with no documented exception on this path. u1-api-contract's BR3.3 marks the reply text untrusted at the type boundary

functional-spec.md > Workflow 1 step 1 and Workflow 4, and frontend-components.md > GuestSkeleton — a skeleton of the identity block and tab bar, never a blank page and never a full-page spinner ahead of identity

functional-spec.md > Workflow 4, failed row, and frontend-components.md > FailedLoadNotice — an error with a retry. u3-foundation's BR4.2 is what guarantees a non-envelope failure resolves to something renderable rather than an unhandled parse error

functional-spec.md > Workflow 4 ('Why the rate-limited state gets its own screen'), and frontend-components.md > RateLimitedNotice — a specific too-many-requests state, never folded into the generic error, because a shared address rate-limits unrelated guests at once. u3-foundation's BR4.4 keeps RATE_LIMITED a distinct code. No countdown: Retry-After is unreadable cross-origin
